actions.description:
@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ReactiveStrike]

If the grand inquisitor's attack hits and this reaction was triggered by a frightened creature, the triggering action is disrupted.
actions.name: Reactive Strike

actions.description: The grand inquisitor Demoralizes. On a success, the target is Stunned with a value equal to its Frightened condition.
actions.name: Condemn

actions.description: The grand inquisitor vows to bring down all the fury of a nation down upon their foes. Up to three lower-level allies within 60 feet of the grand inquisitor can use their reaction to Grapple, Strike, or Trip with a +2 status bonus.
actions.name: I Am the Law!

actions.description: 30 feet. When an opponent ends its turn in the aura, it must attempt a @Check[will|dc:36] save or it becomes Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure), and the grand inquisitor learns its surface thoughts (and underlying motive on a critical failure).
actions.name: Searching Gaze

actions.description: 60 feet. Allies in the aura who are 14th level and lower and are loyal to the grand inquisitor's cause get a +3 status bonus to Will saves.
actions.name: Symbol of Loyalty

actions.description: The grand inquisitor's Strikes deal an extra 3d6 precision damage to Frightened creatures.
actions.name: Twisting Fear

name: Grand Inquisitor
publicNotes:
A grand inquisitor leads powerful governmental forces. They're often champions of oppressive empires or overzealous intelligence networks.

Larger societies rely on those with the authority and the ability to interpret and enforce laws. Some carry out these duties fairly, but others are harsh and cruel, imposing severe punishments on anyone unable to pay for clemency.
